gap_details.2011-2012: SIGNIFICANT. residents.asp has no capture between 2010-06-12 (still the 2009-10 list) and 2014-11-22. Dept homepage 2012-2014 (Ektron default.asp) has no residents link (linkit.aspx IDs all resolve to medschool pages). umm.edu residency_program.htm / neurosurgery-residency pages carry no names. medschool.umaryland.edu and umm.edu year-by-year CDX scans found no other roster URL. Common Crawl 2012..2016 (30 crawls) had no roster-like URL on neurosurgery.umaryland.edu. Reconstructed 13 from 2009-10 and 2014-15 rosters and the alumni page. Ryan Nowak (PGY-2 on 2009-10, Slavin's classmate, not on alumni list) cannot be placed: he left sometime between 2009-10 and 2014-15.
gap_details.2012-2013: SIGNIFICANT. Same gap as 2011-12. Reconstructed 13; Hayman/Jones (PGY-1) placed from their PGY-3 listing on 2014-15 and alumni class of 2019.
gap_details.2013-2014: SIGNIFICANT. Same gap. Reconstructed 13; Kole/Mushlin PGY-1 from PGY-2 on 2014-15 and alumni class of 2020.
gap_details.2014-2015: residents.asp 2014-11-22, header 'Neurosurgery Residents ~ 2014-2015'. Complete: 13 (class of 2015 = Slavin only).
gap_details.2015-2016: SIGNIFICANT. All residents.asp captures 2015-05..2016-10 (5 content versions) still show the '2014-2015' list; new site's first capture 2017-03-31 also shows it. Reconstructed all 14 (bracketed by 2014-15 and 2016-17 rosters; Cannarsa/Chryssikos PGY-1 from PGY-2 on 2016-17 and alumni class of 2022).
gap_details.2016-2017: No Aug-Jan capture with the new list; 2017-04-13 (spring) is the first 2016-17 version (Lewis/Patel PGY-7).
gap_details.2017-2018: Page stale (2016-17 list) through 2018-03-31; 2018-05-15 capture is the 2017-18 list (Han/Sharma PGY-1, Hersh/Le PGY-7). Spring capture.
gap_details.2019-2020: 2019-08-26 capture (last capture of the umaryland page; umms.org roster page not captured until 2020-09).
